name: Kerbalism elected, reliability off
description: Kerbalism installed and TestFlight not, so TestFlight's Uplink is absent from the roster and Kerbalism's provider wins the reliability election by default. Kerbalism's reliability feature is off in this install's own KerbalismConfig/Settings.cfg, so the elected backend reports coverage 'disabled': the copy that renders from it names the BACKEND, never the save, because 'kerbalism is not modelling reliability' is true whether the player switched failures off or another mod owns them.
